sentences.en: Sami, a transsexual, created an alter ego he named Layla.
sentences.zh: 1. 萨米是一位变性人，创造了一个名为莱拉的另一个自我。

sentences.en: What you're saying is just puffery to feed my ego.
sentences.zh: 2. 你所说的不过是吹捧我的自尊心的话。

sentences.en: An arrogant person needs to keep their ego in check.
sentences.zh: 3. 一个傲慢的人需要控制自己的自负。

senses.zh: 自我,自负,自尊心,自我意识
